purpose: Phase-6D tumour treatment-response STATE vocabulary + burden semantics + response thresholds. A SCHEMATIC virtual tumour-cell burden (normalized 0-1 relative to a simulation baseline of 1.0) and a treatment-response trajectory. Burden is NEVER a real tumour volume (mm3) / diameter / weight / cellularity / RECIST measurement. The simulator STOPS at the schematic response trajectory; no clinical / survival / patient outcome is represented.

burden_semantics.normalized: Relative tumour burden is normalized and schematic unless primary quantitative data are explicitly loaded (none are).
burden_semantics.no_negative: Burden never goes below lower_bound; reaching lower_bound is NOT a clinical cure - prefer minimal_residual_burden.
burden_semantics.viable_apoptotic_terminal: normalized_viable_burden + normalized_apoptotic_burden (+ terminal) partition the current burden; viable = current_burden * population living fraction (schematic coupling).

response_states.description: No treatment applied; schematic baseline growth (control reference).
Net growth pressure still positive under treatment.
Growth pressure reduced but net still non-negative.
Growth and loss pressure roughly balanced; burden ~ constant.
Loss pressure exceeds growth; burden gradually declining.
Sustained strong net loss; burden declining faster.
Burden at a low schematic plateau (NOT a cure).
Surviving viable fraction remains after treatment stop (prediction-ready).
Growth pressure recovering; burden rising again.
Trajectory did not resolve within the schematic window.

response_thresholds.thresholds_basis: SCHEMATIC ordinal boundaries on the normalized net growth pressure and burden. NOT measured growth constants, kill coefficients, or % tumour-growth inhibition.

stop_boundary: schematic tumour-response trajectory (growth / stabilization / regression / rebound state) + normalized burden
